india.one_line: IndiaAI Mission and BharatGen release new domestic models, while Airtel invests in Assam data centres and OpenAI settles a dispute.

themes.title: New domestic models launch under IndiaAI Mission
themes.text: BharatGen released Patram 1.5, a 7.8B open-weight vision-language model for multilingual documents, while Chariot AI unveiled its Chariot-1 LLM and speech models under the IndiaAI Mission.

stories.headline: BharatGen launches Patram 1.5, a 7B vision-language model for documents
Chariot AI unveils Chariot-1 LLM and speech models under IndiaAI Mission

themes.title: Airtel invests in Assam data centres
themes.text: Bharti Airtel signed an MoU with the Assam government to invest ₹1,200 crore in three data centres with a combined capacity of 40 MW by 2028.

stories.headline: Bharti Airtel to invest ₹1,200 crore in three Assam data centres

themes.title: IndiaMART settles dispute with OpenAI
themes.text: IndiaMART settled its legal dispute with OpenAI out of court after alleging that ChatGPT selectively excluded its seller listings.

stories.headline: IndiaMART settles dispute with OpenAI over ChatGPT link exclusions
